name: build-menu
description: Key hints, the Cargos tab and the real Ctrl+Alt clicks (cannot be pressed by the lab)

steps.message: Open the build menu: is there a 5th Cargos tab, and do the Pack cargo / Repack hints show in the key hint bar?
Select a wood piece, Ctrl+Alt + left click: a cargo appears in the inventory and the materials are gone. Ctrl+Alt + right click on it: materials come back.
Build the piece from the cargo, then Alt + destroy it: do you get the cargo back? Die with a cargo: is it in the gravestone?
